headline: Mooring County Hold Narrowed as Weathered Expanse Becomes Busiest Front
war_summary: The lines have moved back toward the Wardens in Mooring County since this office's last edition. That district, which stood at eight Colonial works to four at the earlier filing, now reads six Colonial, five Warden and one ruin, though it remains among the war's busiest grounds with fifty-three actions in the past day, fourteen in six hours and nine in the last two. Weathered Expanse, quieter in our previous report, has become the heaviest-fought sector on the board: its nine works are split three Colonial, three Warden and three ruin, with fifty-seven actions in twenty-four hours and thirteen in the last two. Linn Mercy, nine Colonial works and one Warden last edition, now stands seven Colonial, two Warden and two ruin, with eight actions in two hours. Callum's Cape has eased to five Colonial, one Warden and one ruin, two actions in two hours after seven in six. Marban Hollow holds four Warden works to three Colonial and a ruin, a single action in six hours. Dead Lands, Stlican Shelf, Stonecradle and Callahan's Passage report heavy accumulated losses but no ownership changes of late.
